title: ADAS Sensor Calibrations Customer Relations Memo: Goodwill Limits and the Cap on Alignment Comeback Credits
content:
The comeback credit on an ADAS Sensor Calibrations order is capped at the tier's goodwill credit authority for the order less the goodwill already written off on it, except that the cap is twice that authority where the repair was of a structural class and the comeback window is no more than 90 days, and one and a half times that authority where the repair was of a structural class and the window is more than 90 days or the repair was of a non-structural class and the window is no more than 30 days; any other goodwill write-off on the order stays capped at the tier's goodwill credit authority less the goodwill already written off on it, beyond which the request is declined.

## Terms

- **The repair** is the vehicle's network insurance claim repair, as recorded on its Insurance Claim Repairs record; its class is structural where the class name contains the word Structural.
- **Goodwill already written off** is the total of the goodwill write-offs already booked on the order.
- **The comeback window** is counted in calendar days.

## Cap by class and window

| Repair class | Comeback window | Cap before goodwill already written off |
|---|---|---|
| structural | no more than 90 days | twice the tier's goodwill credit authority (multiple 2) |
| structural | more than 90 days | one and a half times the authority (multiple 1.5) |
| non-structural | no more than 30 days | one and a half times the authority (multiple 1.5) |
| non-structural | more than 30 days | the tier's goodwill credit authority |

## Tier figures

| Tier | Goodwill credit authority, USD | Twice the authority | One and a half times the authority |
|---|---|---|---|
| Dynamic Camera Calibration | 25.00 | 50.00 | 37.50 |
| Static Camera Calibration | 35.00 | 70.00 | 52.50 |
| Dual-Mode Camera Calibration | 45.00 | 90.00 | 67.50 |
| Blind Spot Radar Calibration | 35.00 | 70.00 | 52.50 |
| Front Radar Calibration | 45.00 | 90.00 | 67.50 |
| Multi-System Calibration | 90.00 | 180.00 | 135.00 |

## Cases (hypothetical)

- Dual-Mode Camera Calibration order, structural repair, window 60 days, 20.00 USD of goodwill already written off: the cap is 90.00 less 20.00, that is 70.00 USD.
- The same order with a window of 120 days: 67.50 less 20.00, that is 47.50 USD.
- Static Camera Calibration order, non-structural repair, window 25 days, nothing written off yet: 52.50 USD.
- Static Camera Calibration order, non-structural repair, window 31 days: 35.00 USD.
- A goodwill write-off on a Static Camera Calibration order that is not a comeback credit, with 30.00 USD of goodwill already written off: capped at 35.00 less 30.00, that is 5.00 USD; a request beyond that is declined.
